policy: Evidence labels are descriptive. Unknown is not compatible-by-default.

evidence_labels.physical_validated: Executed on named real hardware/image against the v1 physical checklist.
evidence_labels.ci_validated: Automated/off-Pi behavior validated; no physical compatibility claim.
evidence_labels.community_reported: Reported by users but not reproduced by maintainers.

rows.notes: Validates PwnDoctor v1 engine, policy, Patient Chart v2 migrations, Condition Packs, provider hub, cached catalog trust boundary, treatment decision trace, learned remedy safeguards, recovery posture, support bundle, validation recorder and release assembly through the fake Pwnagotchi harness. This does not establish physical radio/display/service compatibility.
